Recording._lifecycle_comment: Lifecycle controls (roadmap #11). EncryptAtRest encrypts track files with AES-256-CTR keyed off DataProtection:MasterKeyPassphrase (seekable; losing the passphrase makes recordings unrecoverable). RetentionDays deletes recordings older than N days (0 = keep forever). MaxTotalGB caps total recordings size, purging oldest first (0 = no cap). RetentionSweepHours sets the purge cadence.

Sessions._comment: MaxConcurrentPerUser caps simultaneous live console sessions per user (0 = unlimited). Redirect/handover continuation legs do not count against it.

Mfa._comment: Multi-factor enforcement. Identity always challenges users who have an authenticator enrolled; these settings decide who MUST enroll. RequireForAll forces every user; RequiredRoles forces members of the listed roles. If neither is set, MFA is required for Admins by default.

RateLimiting._comment: IP-based fixed-window throttles. 'Auth' covers the Identity login/register/password pages; 'Ws' covers the RDP WebSocket relay handshake. Rejected requests get HTTP 429.

DataProtection._comment: MasterKeyPassphrase encrypts the credential keyring at rest and is REQUIRED in Production. Do NOT set it here — supply it out-of-band via the DataProtection__MasterKeyPassphrase environment variable or a secret store.
